migraine.recommendation: Rest in a dark room. Take pain relief. Consult a doctor if severe.

cold.recommendation: Stay hydrated, rest. Consult a doctor if it lasts more than 7 days.

allergy.recommendation: Consider antihistamines. If breathing is difficult, seek emergency care immediately.

sprain.recommendation: Apply ICE (Ice, Compression, Elevation). Do not move it.

fever.recommendation: Stay hydrated, take paracetamol. Seek medical help if fever exceeds 3 days.

food_poisoning.recommendation: Drink ORS, stay hydrated. Consult doctor if severe dehydration occurs.

gastritis.recommendation: Avoid spicy food. Eat small meals. Take antacids if needed.

dehydration.recommendation: Drink plenty of water or ORS. Seek care if symptoms worsen.

asthma.recommendation: Use inhaler immediately. Seek emergency help if breathing is severe.

covid.recommendation: Isolate yourself. Get tested. Consult a doctor if symptoms worsen.

diabetes.recommendation: Check blood sugar levels. Consult a doctor for diagnosis.

hypertension.recommendation: Reduce salt intake. Monitor BP regularly. Consult a doctor.

anemia.recommendation: Increase iron-rich foods. Consult doctor for blood test.

urinary_infection.recommendation: Drink water. Consult doctor for antibiotics.

depression.recommendation: Talk to someone you trust. Seek professional mental health support.
